rationale: Kaarel and Sharon both work in the AI agent infrastructure and LLM tooling space—Kaarel as a founding ML engineer shipping fast at Known.com, and Sharon as a partner building production-ready agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai across biotech, healthtech, and fintech. Kaarel's conviction that shipping speed signals engineering competence and his track record of rapid prototyping could complement Sharon's focus on production-grade agentic systems, making them natural collaborators for exploring how hackathon-velocity solutions scale into enterprise AI infrastructure.
intro_message: Kaarel Kaarelson, meet Sharon — you're both deep in AI agents and LLM tooling from different angles (founding ML engineer vs. infrastructure partner), and your approaches to shipping speed and production readiness could be a powerful complement.
